snippet.title: Tiny Chills | Demo Available Now | CRTime
snippet.description:
There are weird goings on in the once quiet town of Velviano. The town shakes from frequent earthquakes, and residents have started going missing leaving local police baffled. There’s only one place young Fiorenzo can begin his search for answers…  The ear canal! 

It’s time to dig deep.

Play the demo and wishlist on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5237240/Tiny_Chills__Not_From_Ear_Demo

Coming soon to XBOX on PC.
